Records.description: Non-planar (crossed) double-box integral family (N12) for two-loop $qq' \to V_1^* V_2^*$ with massless internal lines and two off-shell external legs. Momentum mapping $p_{1,\mathrm{fam}}=-q_4$, $p_{2,\mathrm{fam}}=-q_3$, $p_{3,\mathrm{fam}}=q_2$, $p_{4,\mathrm{fam}}=q_1$; Mandelstam: $s_\mathrm{fam}=S$, $t_\mathrm{fam}=T$, $u_\mathrm{fam}=U$. Master integrals computed via canonical differential equations in arXiv:1404.5590.

Records.description: Called $I_4(x,z)$ in the paper. 2-loop 4-point master integral for $q\bar{q} \to VV$ planar topologies from Gehrmann, Tancredi, Weihs (1306.6344). 7 massless propagators in planar double box. Two massless on-shell legs ($p_1,p_2$) and two off-shell legs ($q_1,q_2$). Depends on $(x,z)$. Prefactor $P_4(x,z)=x^2/(m^6 z (1+x)^4)$. Symbol Galois-even ($x\to 1/x$ invariant). Fitted at $\varepsilon^0$ (weight 4) with galois uniform basis of 633 functions. AMFlow: 5.4 CPU-h/point, 332 points, 28 digits. Reduction: 9.4 h.
